_comment: Copy to ads.config.json (gitignored) to turn monetization on. Absent or enabled:false means no ads at all, which is the default for source builds, forks, and distro packages.
_manifestUrl: Campaign manifest, served as static JSON over https. Build it with: npm run ads:build
_affiliates: Program slug -> your affiliate id. A campaign whose {{affiliate:slug}} is missing here is skipped rather than sent untracked, so filling this in is what switches paid inventory on.
_network: Third-party ad network. Runs only when BOTH provider and tagHtml are set. Paste the network's tag snippet verbatim into tagHtml; it executes in an isolated view with its own session and no bridge back to the app. Leave slots empty to allow every slot. NOTE: AdSense forbids Electron/app-wrapper inventory — do not use it here.
_entitlement: Ed25519 public key that remove-ads licences are checked against. Generate with: npm run ads:keygen
